nodes.description: Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the proxy implementation address (EIP-1967 implementation slot).
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the proxy admin address (EIP-1967 admin slot).
Payable external fallback() that immediately forwards to _fallback().
Payable external receive() that immediately forwards to _fallback().
Abstract internal view that must return the implementation address.
Internal function that performs an inline-assembly delegatecall to the implementation and bubbles the result.
Virtual internal hook executed at the start of _fallback, overridable by derived contracts.
Core fallback logic: checks OpenZeppelinUpgradesAddress.isContract(msg.sender), msg.data.length and gasleft(), then calls _willFallback and _delegate(_implementation()).
Reads the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via inline assembly sload.
Internal upgrade routine that sets the new implementation and emits Upgraded.
Validates newImplementation is a contract then writes it to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with sstore.
Modifier that compares msg.sender with _admin(); admin branch executes the body, otherwise it delegates via _fallback().
External admin-guarded getter returning the admin address from _admin().
External admin-guarded getter returning the implementation address from _implementation().
External admin-guarded function that changes the proxy admin after rejecting the zero address.
External admin-guarded function that upgrades the implementation via _upgradeTo.
Payable external admin-guarded function that upgrades the implementation and then delegatecalls arbitrary caller-supplied data on the new implementation.
Internal view returning the admin address read from ADMIN_SLOT via inline assembly sload.
Internal function that writes newAdmin into ADMIN_SLOT via inline assembly sstore.
Overrides _willFallback and requires msg.sender != _admin() so the admin cannot use the fallback path.
Constructor that asserts the slot constant, sets the implementation and optionally delegatecalls init data on _logic.
Constructor that chains to UpgradeabilityProxy, asserts ADMIN_SLOT and sets the initial admin.
Overrides _willFallback and dispatches to super._willFallback() (BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy).
Public payable initializer requiring an empty implementation slot, then sets the implementation and optionally delegatecalls init data.
Public payable initializer that requires an empty implementation slot, initializes the logic/data and then sets the admin.
Library view helper using extcodesize to determine whether an address is a contract.
Caller-controlled address used for admin checks in ifAdmin/_willFallback and for the isContract check in _fallback.
Inline-assembly delegatecall(gas(), implementation, 0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) executed inside Proxy._delegate.
High-level newImplementation.delegatecall(data) executed inside upgradeToAndCall with caller-supplied data.
_logic.delegatecall(_data) executed in the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor when init data is provided.
_logic.delegatecall(_data) executed in InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize when init data is provided.
Inline-assembly sstore(slot, newImplementation) writing the implementation slot.
Inline-assembly sstore(slot, newAdmin) writing the admin slot.
Inline-assembly extcodesize(account) used to detect contract accounts.
Inline-assembly sload(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT) reading the implementation address.
Inline-assembly sload(ADMIN_SLOT) reading the admin address.
Address parameter of Proxy._delegate that is used as the delegatecall target.
Address parameter of _upgradeTo/_setImplementation/upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall used as the new implementation.
Address parameter of changeAdmin/_setAdmin used as the new proxy admin.
Calldata bytes parameter of upgradeToAndCall forwarded to the delegatecall.
Address parameter _logic of the constructors and initializers (initial implementation).
Bytes parameter _data of the constructors and initializers forwarded to the delegatecall.
Address parameter _admin of AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor and InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize.
Address parameter of OpenZeppelinUpgradesAddress.isContract passed to extcodesize.
Local bytes32 slot variable holding IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT or ADMIN_SLOT for assembly sload/sstore.
Assembly local `result` holding the delegatecall return flag in Proxy._delegate.
Local bool success returned by low-level delegatecall and checked with require.
Named return variable `impl` of BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._implementation populated by sload.
Named return variable `adm` of BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._admin populated by sload.
Local uint256 size in isContract that receives extcodesize(account).

edges.reason: fallback() immediately calls _fallback().
receive() immediately calls _fallback().
_fallback invokes the _willFallback hook before delegating.
_fallback calls _delegate(_implementation()).
_fallback reads the implementation address from _implementation().
_delegate executes the inline-assembly delegatecall.
upgradeToAndCall performs a delegatecall with caller-supplied data.
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor delegatecalls _data on _logic.
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize delegatecalls _data on _logic.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize calls InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize writes the admin via _setAdmin.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor chains to UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor sets the initial admin via _setAdmin.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback dispatches to super (BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy) which enforces the admin check.
_willFallback compares msg.sender against _admin().
ifAdmin modifier reads the admin address from _admin().
ifAdmin modifier delegates non-admin callers to _fallback().
changeAdmin writes the new admin through _setAdmin.
upgradeTo calls _upgradeTo (admin-guarded implementation change).
upgradeToAndCall calls _upgradeTo before the delegatecall.
_upgradeTo writes the new implementation via _setImplementation.
_setImplementation validates the new implementation with isContract.
_setImplementation performs the sstore to the implementation slot.
_setAdmin performs the sstore to the admin slot.
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor sets the initial implementation via _setImplementation.
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize sets the implementation via _setImplementation.
_admin performs the inline-assembly sload on ADMIN_SLOT.
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._implementation performs the inline-assembly sload on IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
isContract performs the inline-assembly extcodesize check.
admin() returns the value of _admin().
implementation() returns the value of _implementation().
msg.sender is compared with _admin() inside the ifAdmin modifier, gating privileged functions.
msg.sender is compared with _admin() in _willFallback to block the admin from the fallback path.
msg.sender is passed to OpenZeppelinUpgradesAddress.isContract inside _fallback (gas/code-size dependent branch).
implementation parameter is the target address of the delegatecall in _delegate.
newImplementation parameter is written into the implementation slot.
newAdmin parameter is written into the admin slot.
Caller-supplied data is forwarded to the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall.
newImplementation is the delegatecall target in upgradeToAndCall.
_logic is the delegatecall target in the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
_data is forwarded to the delegatecall in the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
_logic is the delegatecall target in InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize.
_data is forwarded to the delegatecall in InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize.
_admin parameter flows into the sstore performed by _setAdmin.
account parameter flows into extcodesize inside isContract.
local slot variable is used as the sload argument for the implementation slot.
local slot variable is used as the sload argument for the admin slot.
delegatecall result flag is consumed by the assembly switch in _delegate.
success flag of the delegatecall is checked by require in upgradeToAndCall.
impl return variable is populated by the sload in _implementation.
adm return variable is populated by the sload in _admin.
size local variable receives extcodesize(account) in isContract.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant is used as the sstore slot for the implementation.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant is used as the sload slot for the implementation.
ADMIN_SLOT constant is used as the sstore slot for the admin.
ADMIN_SLOT constant is used as the sload slot for the admin.
delegatecall executes untrusted implementation code in the proxy's context, which can re-enter _fallback.
delegatecall to an arbitrary new implementation with attacker-controlled data can call back into the proxy.
constructor delegatecall into _logic with init data executes external code that can call back into the proxy.
initialize delegatecall into _logic with init data executes external code that can call back into the proxy.

normalization_plan.reason: The implementation parameter only exists to feed the delegatecall target inside Proxy._delegate, so it should be folded into that function node.
newImplementation flows directly into the implementation slot write and the upgrade entry points; it should be normalized into _setImplementation.
newAdmin is only used to write ADMIN_SLOT, so it should be merged into the _setAdmin function node.
The data parameter is only relevant as the payload of the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall.
_logic is the initial implementation address consumed by the constructor's delegatecall/setup logic.
_data is only used as the constructor delegatecall payload and carries no standalone semantics.
The _admin parameter is only used to initialize the admin slot during construction/initialization.
account is used solely as the extcodesize input in isContract.
The slot local is a temporary alias for IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT/ADMIN_SLOT used only for assembly sload access.
The assembly result flag exists only to branch on the delegatecall outcome inside Proxy._delegate.
The success boolean is only the return flag of the low-level delegatecall and is consumed by require.
impl is a named return variable populated directly by the sload in _implementation.
adm is a named return variable populated directly by the sload in _admin.
size only stores the extcodesize result and is compared with zero inside isContract.
